description: Read the person’s Saved: the grid of live cards they keep, in folders, each read again whenever it’s opened. Without ids: every folder and card, each card’s id, title, number now and its move (folder: just that folder). With ids (up to 6): those cards read again now, each with its rows; folder with rows true does that for the folder’s cards. This only reads; track makes and changes cards. Opens with RoBot: an account RoBot isn’t open on yet gets not_available.

folder.description: A folder’s name or id: only that folder (optional)

ids.description: Cards’ ids (12 characters each, from the list): those cards whole, with their rows (optional)

rows.description: With folder: its cards whole, with their rows, as with ids

name: saved
title: Your Saved
